answer: A concrete resistance design grows each identity along a public trellis of peer-attested original judgments that cannot be bulk-copied. Entry is fixed at a registration wharf that records a unique commitment; later work must flow like a continuous river from that origin so peers can audit continuity. An attacker spinning fake accounts must invent coherent histories for each one from the first dock onward, paying super-linear originality cost and risking detection when branches fail cross-check.
